infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Doodle Reminders needs access to your contacts to help you find and add friends.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Doodle Reminders needs access to your camera to capture sketches, photos, or doodles for reminders.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Doodle Reminders needs access to your microphone to record audio notes for your reminders.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Doodle Reminders needs access to your photo library to save and load custom doodles or images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Doodle Reminders needs access to your photo library to save custom doodles.
